pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions of medium brown. Edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients with some slight curvature. Patch size is largest on the central flank and decreases in spatial area toward the posterior and lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-cream interstitial lines. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, thinning slightly toward the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane consists of short, densely packed vertical bristles. The silhouette against the sky shows a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, circular lesion with exposed red/pink tissue is visible on the posterior rump, showing a clear disruption of the epidermal layer and pelage pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Five small, dark-feathered birds are attached to the lateral and ventral surfaces of the neck and shoulder, creating localized occlusions of the pelage pattern.
